facts.question: How many Ballon d'Or awards has Lionel Messi won?
facts.statement: Lionel Messi has won 8 Ballon d'Or awards.
facts.explanation: Messi's eight Ballon d'Or wins are the most by any player.

facts.question: How many FIFA World Cups has Brazil won?
facts.statement: Brazil have won 5 FIFA World Cups.
facts.explanation: Brazil won in 1958, 1962, 1970, 1994 and 2002 — more than any other nation.

facts.question: How many goals did Miroslav Klose score across FIFA World Cups?
facts.statement: Miroslav Klose scored 16 goals across FIFA World Cups.
facts.explanation: Klose's 16 goals across four tournaments is the World Cup record.

facts.question: How many UEFA Champions League titles have Real Madrid won?
facts.statement: Real Madrid have won 15 UEFA Champions League titles.
facts.explanation: Real Madrid's 15th European crown came in 2024 against Borussia Dortmund.

facts.question: Which country did Argentina beat in the 2022 FIFA World Cup final?
facts.statement: Argentina beat France in the 2022 FIFA World Cup final.
facts.explanation: Argentina won on penalties after a 3-3 draw in Qatar.

facts.question: How many UEFA Champions League goals did Cristiano Ronaldo score?
facts.statement: Cristiano Ronaldo scored 140 UEFA Champions League goals.
facts.explanation: Ronaldo's 140 goals is the competition's all-time record.

facts.question: How many Premier League titles have Manchester United won?
facts.statement: Manchester United have won 13 Premier League titles.
facts.explanation: United won 13 titles between the 1992-93 and 2012-13 seasons, all under Alex Ferguson.

facts.question: How many players from each team start a football match?
facts.statement: Each team starts a football match with 11 players.
facts.explanation: Laws of the Game require 11 per side, including the goalkeeper, and a minimum of seven to continue.

facts.question: How many goals did Just Fontaine score at the 1958 World Cup?
facts.statement: Just Fontaine scored 13 goals at the 1958 World Cup.
facts.explanation: Fontaine's 13 goals in a single tournament remain a World Cup record.

facts.question: How many FIFA World Cups has Germany won?
facts.statement: Germany have won 4 FIFA World Cups.
facts.explanation: West Germany won in 1954, 1974 and 1990; a reunified Germany added 2014.

facts.question: How many World Cups did Pele win with Brazil?
facts.statement: Pele won 3 World Cups with Brazil.
facts.explanation: Pele was part of the 1958, 1962 and 1970 winning squads, though injury limited him in 1962.

facts.question: How many goals did Erling Haaland score in the 2022-23 Premier League season?
facts.statement: Erling Haaland scored 36 goals in the 2022-23 Premier League season.
facts.explanation: Haaland's 36 broke the 38-game Premier League single-season record of 32.
